name: Ring 2.6 1T
short: InclusionAI's open-weights reasoning MoE (1T total/63B active, MIT, 128K native/256K YaRN) for maths and research at high/xhigh effort: GPQA 88.3%, AIME 2026 95.8%.
pricingNote: AA ~$0.30/$2.50 per 1M (cache $0.06); MIT open weights, but self-hosting needs ~32 GPUs
freeTierNote: Free OpenRouter endpoint at $0.00/1M. Hugging Face reports no Inference Provider deploys the weights directly.
standout: Open-weight thinking at 1T scale: adjustable high/xhigh reasoning with GPQA 88.3% and ARC-AGI-2 66.2%.
tradeoff: No Terminal-Bench was ever published, MRCR rows in the report belong to Ling 2.6, and OpenRouter has no live endpoint for it.
